_meta.note: Four dataType variants of the same endpoint plus the bare TVL endpoint. TRAP: /tvl/{slug} returns a BARE NUMBER, not a JSON object -- json.loads gives a float, and any code doing response['tvl'] breaks. Second trap: DefiLlama TVL is far below the FWA core contract's real ETH balance; they measure different things and the onchain balance is the one to show.
